title: One deploy adapter is the sole caller of the deploy CLI
iWant: a single named module every path imports to talk to the deploy vendor
soThat: changing vendors is a one-module change and duplicate CLI call paths cannot drift

acceptanceCriteria.description: The project exposes one Deploy Adapter module whose public surface is `uploadVersion`, `promoteVersion`, `listVersions`, `resolveNewestOfMain`, and `describeVersion`; the module is the only source file that spawns the vendor CLI binary or imports the vendor's deploy SDK.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a project that has applied the blueprint and realised TAC-1301
acceptanceCriteria.when: the source tree is scanned for spawns of `wrangler` (or the vendor's CLI binary name) and for imports of the vendor's deploy SDK identifier
acceptanceCriteria.then: the only source file that matches either scan is the Deploy Adapter module; no other module names an alternative deploy call path

acceptanceCriteria.description: The adapter's `uploadVersion({ previewAlias })` verb returns `{ versionId, versionIdUrl, previewAliasUrl }` on success and refuses to complete when the alias argument is empty.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a Deploy Adapter instance backed by the default vendor
acceptanceCriteria.then: the call resolves with a `versionId` string matching the vendor's version-id format, a `versionIdUrl` naming the per-version URL, and a `previewAliasUrl` whose host segment carries the alias `main`; a call with `previewAlias: ''` throws a `DEPLOY_PREVIEW_ALIAS_REQUIRED` error

acceptanceCriteria.description: The adapter's `promoteVersion({ versionId })` verb refuses when `versionId` is not present in `listVersions()`.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an adapter whose `listVersions()` returns a set that does not include the id `bogus-v1`
acceptanceCriteria.then: the call throws a `DEPLOY_VERSION_NOT_FOUND` error naming `bogus-v1` and no vendor promote call is issued
